description: This file defines the enumeration 'EmailCampaignType' representing different types of email campaigns within the system, including methods for type conversion and checks.

classes.name: EmailCampaignType
classes.description: An enum representing various email campaign types: DIRECT, SCHEDULE, and TRIGGERED.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the email campaign type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the email campaign type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding EmailCampaignType enum value.

methods.name: isDirect
methods.description: Checks if the email campaign type is DIRECT.

methods.name: isSchedule
methods.description: Checks if the email campaign type is SCHEDULE.

methods.name: isTriggered
methods.description: Checks if the email campaign type is TRIGGERED.
